body_text:
A sentence is *valid* if it is true in every interpretation,
and *satisfiable* if it is true in at least one interpretation.
A theory is satisfiable when its sentences have a common model.
Satisfiability is therefore a global compatibility condition,
not the claim that each axiom can be satisfied separately.
